Examples of these risks, uncertainties and other factors include, but are not limited to, those discussed in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and, in particular, the risks discussed under the caption "Risk Factors” in Part I, Item 1A herein. All forward-looking statements made in this Annual Report on Form 10-K speak only as of the date of this filing. Given these risks and uncertainties, readers are cautioned not to place undue reliance on such forward-looking statements. We undertake no obligation to publicly update or revise any forward-looking statements, whether as a result of new information, future events or otherwise. Overview The discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations is organized to present the following: • a review of our critical accounting policies and estimates and of our financial presentation, including discussion of certain operational and financial metrics we utilize to assist us in managing our business; • a discussion of our results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the same period in 2024; and • a discussion of our liquidity and capital resources, including our future capital and material cash requirements and potential funding sources. A discussion of our results of operations, and sources and uses of cash for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023 is included in Part II. Item 7. passages.text: - " We are exposed to cybersecurity attacks and data breaches and the risks and costs associated with protecting our systems and maintaining data integrity and security ." Governance Our cybersecurity program is led by our Chief Information Officer (CIO) and the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO ). They are supported by Information Security Officers who work closely with our operational teams. Our CIO and CISO have more than 35 years of collective experience in the cybersecurity field. The CISO reports to the CIO and is generally responsible for management of cybersecurity risk and the protection and defense of our networks, systems, and data. The CISO has served in similar roles at three major public companies and is a recognized cybersecurity leader. He regularly engages with peer CISOs, cybersecurity experts and organizations, including the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) and the NIST, to stay informed on the latest industry developments. The CISO regularly informs our internal Disclosure Committee, Chief Financial Officer, and our Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of cybersecurity risks and incidents as per our internal cyber risk 24 framework. This also helps ensure that the highest levels of management are kept abreast of our cybersecurity posture and potential risks. Our Board , in coordination with the Audit Committee, is actively engaged in reviewing management's processes for assessing and managing cybersecurity risks. The Board reviews cybersecurity at least annually. The Audit Committee directly oversees the Company’s management of cybersecurity risks. On a quarterly basis or as needed, the Audit Committee receives updates from management (including the CIO and CISO) on cybersecurity risks resulting from risk assessments, progress of risk reduction initiatives, external auditor feedback, control maturity assessments, and relevant internal and industry cybersecurity incidents. In addition, the Chair of the Audit Committee regularly informs the Board of the outcome of the Audit Committee's reviews at scheduled Board meetings. Item 2. credit_strengths.text: Revenue and operating income have grown steadily across the three-year trend, with the operating margin now well above the sector median, reflecting strong pricing and onboard spending across the cruise fleet. This earnings momentum underpins cash generation and supports the current leverage profile.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure and leaves positive free cash flow, while interest coverage remains adequate relative to the cost of debt. Cash flow to debt sits near the sector median, indicating the business can service obligations from internally generated funds.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a new share repurchase authorization alongside a declared dividend, meaning shareholder returns now absorb most free cash flow. With capital commitments for new ships, this limits deleveraging capacity and keeps leverage above the sector median, leaving thin headroom to the next risk tier.

The risk factors highlight exposure to cybersecurity attacks and data breaches, which could disrupt operations, trigger regulatory costs and harm brand reputation. For a cruise operator with centralized booking and onboard systems, such an event could materially affect cash flow and liquidity.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Debt maturities are weighted toward the near term, with a substantial portion due within the next twelve months and further repayments in the following two years. This refinancing wall requires consistent access to capital markets or sufficient cash generation to avoid liquidity strain.

The current ratio is far below the sector median, reflecting heavy current liabilities relative to current assets. However, cruise operators typically run negative working capital because customer deposits are current liabilities, so this metric overstates near-term liquidity risk when operating cash flow is strong.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is Significant, with leverage above the sector median and cash flow to debt near the median. The company retains some capacity to absorb an earnings decline before breaching the next leverage threshold, but upgrade potential is limited without further debt reduction.

Our forward view is that credit quality will remain stable if operating cash flow continues to cover capital expenditure and shareholder returns are moderated. A material earnings decline or accelerated buybacks could pressure the profile, while sustained deleveraging would improve it.

credit_strengths.text: 收入及經營溢利於三年趨勢中穩步增長，經營利潤率現時遠高於行業中位數，反映郵輪船隊的定價能力及船上消費強勁。此盈利動力支撐現金產生，並支持當前槓桿狀況。
經營現金流覆蓋資本開支並產生正自由現金流，而利息覆蓋率相對於債務成本仍屬充足。現金流對債務比率接近行業中位數，顯示業務能以內部產生資金償付債務。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露新的股份回購授權及已宣派股息，意味股東回報現時吸收大部分自由現金流。加上新船的資本承擔，這限制了去槓桿能力，並使槓桿維持高於行業中位數，令與下一風險級別的緩衝空間薄弱。
風險因素凸顯網絡安全攻擊及數據洩露的風險敞口，可能干擾營運、引發監管成本並損害品牌聲譽。對於擁有集中式預訂及船上系統的郵輪營運商而言，此類事件可能重大影響現金流及流動性。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 債務到期偏向近期，其中相當部分於未來十二個月內到期，並於隨後兩年有進一步還款。此再融資牆需要持續進入資本市場或足夠的現金產生，以避免流動性壓力。
流動比率遠低於行業中位數，反映流動負債相對於流動資產沉重。然而，郵輪營運商通常因客戶按金屬流動負債而錄得負營運資金，故當經營現金流強勁時，此指標誇大近期流動性風險。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為顯著，槓桿高於行業中位數，而現金流對債務比率接近中位數。公司仍保留一定能力吸收盈利下滑而不觸及下一槓桿門檻，但若無進一步減債，評級上調潛力有限。
我們的前瞻觀點是，若經營現金流繼續覆蓋資本開支且股東回報有所節制，信貸質素將保持穩定。盈利大幅下滑或回購加速可能對狀況構成壓力，而持續去槓桿則會改善狀況。
